results.content: # Building trust through Technology: AI, public service perception, and citizen satisfaction in Abu Dhabi policing. This study examines the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) implementation, perceptions of public services, and trust in government on citizen satisfaction within the Abu Dhabi Police, offering insights into the role of emerging technologies in public administration. A purposive sample of 500 police employees from AI-enabled, operational, and administrative units was surveyed using a structured questionnaire, from which 365 valid responses were analyzed to assess the relationships among AI implementation, perception of public services, trust in government, and citizen satisfaction.
